hub.speaker: Grimalkin
hub.text: Stand up straight when you address me. I measure everything that comes through this office, and most of it is found wanting. State your business.

options.text: I'm here for the forge-tier fitness read. (8 gold)

options._comment: b4 #219 slot gate: a held posting blocks enrollment. The board_accepted bool gate HIDES (both directions, same as Selys's hub) — no visible-locked render exists; the study-loop canonical's mutual-exclusion option pins are the proof.

text_variants.text: The field subject returns. Your engagement data survived review. It is in the literature now; that is the only compliment I issue.
The casting subject. Your wind held past the eighth measure, which surprised exactly one of us. Speak.

exam.speaker: Grimalkin
exam.text: Grip, wind, and whether you quit before I do — three measures. You cleared all three. Barely, on the second. Numbers don't lie, and neither do I: you'll survive the forge tier. The file will say 'adequate.' From me, that is not an insult.

study_enrolled.speaker: Grimalkin
study_enrolled.text: Enrolled. Fight as you would; I will know if you perform for the ledger. Return when the numbers exist.
study_enrolled._comment: b4 #219 enrollment ack. board_accepted:false on the hub's studies entry blocks accept while ANY posting is held (hidden, not locked); studies are re-acceptable after completion or abandon — delta rows are repeatable.

studies.speaker: Grimalkin
studies.text: Two open protocols. Field engagements, or witnessed casting. Both pay on data, neither pays for stories.

options.text: Sign me on as a field subject. Three engagements, logged.
options._comment: b4 review fix: NO hide_when — accepted_bounty_* counters never reset, so hiding on them permanently retired the study after one accept-then-abandon (the hub's board_accepted:false gate already prevents double-accept while a posting is held; delta rows are repeatable by design).

options.text: Measure my casting. Eight witnessed, as posted.
